facebook.caption:
4.8 stars. 1,019 reviews. For bánh mì.

Bánh Mì Sài Gòn - Phú Quốc on Đường Trần Hưng Đạo is not a restaurant. It's a bakery that somehow outscores half the sit-down spots on the island. Crispy baguette, loaded fillings, loose change out of your pocket. This is your breakfast sorted before the beach crowds hit. Save this for your Phu Quoc trip.
facebook.video_caption: Watch the baguette crack when they press it. That sound alone is worth the detour to Bánh Mì Sài Gòn - Phú Quốc. 4.8 stars from over 1,000 people. Breakfast under $5. Go early.
